title: Potato Angels / Eye / Sprout Development Ledger — Earth Angel to Cultivation
purpose: Correct the developmental timeline of Potato Angels, eyes, sprouts and ascent. April 30, 2026 is a cultivation/action stage, not the first Potato-Angel attestation.
rule: Preserve original project wording before later formalization. Distinguish Earth-Angel identity, cultivation imperative, botanical formalization and biblical comparison as separate stages.

stages.development: Potato is already a complete vertical living architecture: Mud/Root/Spiral below, Potato/Earth-Angel middle, North-Pole sprout/staircase upward, Flower/Heaven/Eden above. Angel language is identity/cosmology here, not yet a command to cultivate angels.
The older Earth-Angel identity becomes an imperative: grow/cultivate them, construct roads, repair relations and build Garden infrastructure.

stages.wording_summary: Tim requests biblical reading around chariot of light / Ezekiel / wheels.
stages.development: The angel/eye/sprout field gains wheels, movement, orientation and celestial-throne comparison rather than plant-growth alone.

stages.wording: Potato → eyes → children → sprouts → paths → ladder → ascent
stages.development: The physical potato eye becomes the starting point of a formal continuation/path/ascent grammar.
Cherubim, seraphim, generic messengers, Ezekiel living creatures and Revelation throne creatures are distinguished; service/function is separated from wings/appearance.

genealogy: Earth Angel identity → grow Potato Angels
stored structure/knowledge → deeper spiral understanding/alchemy → cultivation/repair
new_findings: The Earth-Angel phrase predates the April 30 cultivation sequence by almost four months.
Sprout→staircase-to-Heaven is attested January 1, far earlier than the September formal eye→sprout→path→ladder model.
Flower=Heaven/Eden means the project has a botanical completion-state: underground storage/root is not the terminus; flowering expresses the upper/generative state.
The January passage already distinguishes Mud from the Staircase: clinging to roots/strife, rather than root existence itself, turns the lower relation into a hell-path.
House/Seed and Angel/Sprout are therefore not separate late systems; both are already compressed in the January plant cosmology.
corrections_to_apply: Any page or atlas implying April 30 is the first Potato-Angel occurrence should be changed to 'first currently indexed cultivation imperative' or equivalent.
The Bible reader should be able to search January 1 Earth Angels and sprout-staircase material separately from later angelology.
Use January 1 as a reverse-timeline anchor when comparing later Branch, Ladder, messenger or Garden texts.
